title: Rapid touch rotations - daily scratchpad
content:
Morning runbook (blocks)
- 08:30-09:15 quick dials (priority list A) -> focus on conversion plays (2 micro-personal lines)
- 09:30-10:30 email batch (sequences + follow-ups) -> 25 personalized sends (1 sentence personalization + CTA)
- 11:00-11:45 account research + LinkedIn touches (10 accounts)
- 14:00-15:00 demo prep + warm callbacks
- 16:00-17:00 end-of-day wrap, logging, and next-day plan

Today goals
- Dials: 40 (target) / 10 (morning done)
- Emails sent: 25 (target)
- Meetings booked: 3 (target)
- Outreach-to-meeting rate target: 6%

Priority list (quick notes)
1) BlueWave Analytics (BD-847) - VP Data Ops. Left voicemail 07/16, referenced our latency benchmarks. Next touch: 2-line email + demo timeslots. Pain: unpredictable inference spend.
2) Cartella Health (ACCT-193) - Head of ML Eng. Engaged via reply to blog post. Action: Send quantization+cost case study (attach short slide), propose 20-min sync.
3) Nimbus Commerce (TR-521) - CTO. Wants latency SLOs per region. Ask: dedicated vs hosted pricing. Book 30-min tech call.
4) Verdant Media (NEW) - Product lead. Low lifetime value but high potential pilot. Warm intro from partner. Try 15-min exploratory call.

Scripts/snippets (do not memorize, adapt)
- Voicemail: "Hi [first], this is Iris from Redwood Inference — we help teams cut inference cost while keeping latency. Sent over a one-pager — would love 10 minutes to show a quick config that saved another customer ~35% on tokens. If that sounds useful, my calendar is open: [cal link]."
- Short email opener: "Appreciate your post on [topic]. We saw similar issues at a customer (reduced token cost with lightweight KV cache). Quick 15-min call?"
- Follow-up after no reply (3rd touch): "Quick ping — didn't hear back. If not a fit, totally fine; if curious, two slots Wed/Thu morning. Also happy to drop a short tech note."

Cadence rules I'm testing this week
- Rotate 3x phone + 4x email over 14 days
- If no reply after 4 emails and 2 calls, mark as low-touch for 90 days
- Use micro-personalization: reference a recent blog post or a tiny metric (ARR range) rather than long paragraphs

Testing experiments (A/B)
- Subject line A: "Reduce inference cost — quick idea"
- Subject line B: "One config that cut tokens by 30%"
- VM script A vs B on tone (formal vs conversational) - logging responses in sheet (link in linked_artifacts)

Notes from earlier calls
- BlueWave: cares about regulatory regions (EU data residency). Ask product: can customer pin model region? (ticket to infra?)
- Cartella: willing to run 2-week pilot if we handle data ingress checks. Follow-up: send onboarding checklist + security slide.

Next actions (TODAY)
- Send BlueWave short-case + 3 demo slots (after 09:30 batch)
- Draft Cartella security checklist and route to Solutions Eng (Samira) by 11:15
- Block Nimbus for tech deep-dive - propose Wed 10:00

Logging & metrics (personal)
- Add results to my weekly sheet: sales/rapid-rotations-iris-2026 (track touches, replies, meetings)
- Quick KPI to watch: reply rate by subject line, vm-to-call conversion, meetings booked per 100 dials

Random reminders to self
- Trim email signature for first touches (too long)
- Import demo deck version 0.9 that Diego uploaded into my local slides folder
- Call with Diego 17:10 to sync on pilot deck changes

Loose ideas for outreach content
- Short notebook-style case study: "How a 3-step config saved X for fintech" (one-pager)
- 90-second Loom showing how to toggle cache settings in Console (high impact for ops folks)

End of notes - update before EOD with final counts and next day's priority list.
